subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo with the broader committee today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key stakeholders we heard today (please correct me if I missed anyone):
- Tom Garcia — Economic buyer / CFO (primary decision owner for commercial terms)
- Sarah Liu — Security & compliance (evaluating SOC2, network controls, data residency)
- Sandra Park — Procurement (contracting + PO process)
- Ben Carter (Cedar Consulting) — Technical advisor / SRE reviewer

Decision criteria you called out:
- Predictable per-request pricing and clarity on unit economics
- SOC2 Type II evidence and completed security questionnaire
- Support for private deployment (VPC) and customer-managed KMS
- Pilot success criteria: 99th-percentile latency under 250ms for typical queries + cost target under $0.008/token (TBD)

Attachments I’m sharing: Redwood demo deck, our latest SOC2 report, and a draft MSA for procurement to review.

Proposed next steps (timeline to keep this moving):
1) Sarah / Security: We’ll share the security questionnaire and SOC2 doc now — Neha will own answers and any follow-up tech review (target: Mar 3)
2) Procurement: Sandra to confirm contracting timeline & PO needs (target: confirm by Mar 5)
3) Pricing: I’ll share a tailored pricing estimate + recommended pilot scope for Tom by EOD Fri (Feb 27)
4) Technical deep-dive: Neha is available for a 60-min SRE session next week to walk infra and KMS/SSO details.

A couple of immediate asks from our side to help us prepare the pilot:
- Sarah: can you confirm the security questionnaire contact and the RFP deadline?
- Sandra: what contracting standard (MSA/PO) does Acme prefer and any procurement flow we should anticipate?
- Tom: any internal procurement thresholds (e.g., finance approval levels) we should be aware of?

Happy to jump on a quick 15-minute sync if that helps.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Redwood-Demo-Deck.pdf; SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf; MSA-draft-Redwood.docx

From: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>, Sandra Park <sandra.park@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Acme Health)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the materials. Helpful. A few quick items from my side: 

- Pricing: yes please send the pilot estimate. We’ll need a 3-month pilot budgetary number to get initial finance okayed.
- Contracting: our procurement (Sandra) will likely want the MSA + a short SOW. We prefer to route through our standard vendor template; Sandra, I'll let you chime in on any non-starters.
- Approvals: anything above $100k requires VP Finance sign-off — likely me and our CFO. If the pilot is under that, I can approve.

Also looping Ben Carter from Cedar — he’ll do a quick technical sanity check. Ben, appreciate a 30-min look at the infra notes if you have bandwidth.

Tom

- For security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II and the completed questionnaire. Can you confirm a point of contact for the questionnaire?
- Timeline: procurement reviews typically take 7–10 business days once we have the MSA + SOW. If you need faster turnaround, please flag and we can prioritize.

Aditya — FYI on the thread. Tom asked for a 3-month pilot budget number. Procurement asked for MSA redline and SOC2 questionnaire. Neha is taking security.

Two asks for you: 
1) Can you approve offering a 10% pilot discount if they commit to a paid pilot within 30 days? We’ll include standard clause: pilot-to-production conversion within 90 days or pilot terms revert.
2) If approval needed beyond you (price >$100k), flag who needs to sign off.

I’d like to propose we target sharing the pricing estimate EOD Wed so they can get procurement moving.

Thanks —
Marissa
